gateway_host.description: Gateway HTTP bind host. Use 127.0.0.1 unless AstrBot and the Gateway run in different containers.

auto_start_gateway.description: Start the bundled Node.js WhatsApp Gateway automatically when the plugin page is opened.

node_executable.description: Node.js executable used to run the bundled Gateway. Node 20+ is recommended.

auth_dir.description: Directory for WhatsApp Web/Baileys auth state. Empty means ./data/whatsapp-auth under this plugin.

log_level.description: Gateway log level: silent, fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace.

allow_from.description: Default DM allowlist for platform instances that keep the built-in default. Use E.164 numbers like +15551234567. Use ["*"] only if you intentionally accept all DMs.

dm_policy.description: Default direct message policy for platform instances that keep the built-in default: allowlist, open, disabled.

group_policy.description: Default group sender policy for platform instances that keep the built-in default: allowlist, open, disabled.

group_allow_from.description: Default allowed senders in groups. Falls back to allow_from when empty. Use ["*"] only with care.

groups.description: Default allowed WhatsApp group JIDs. Use ["*"] to allow all groups admitted by group_policy.

send_read_receipts.description: Default setting for sending WhatsApp read receipts for accepted inbound messages.

mark_online.description: Mark WhatsApp Web as online/available after connecting. Disable if you prefer invisible-style operation.

media_max_mb.description: Default inbound/outbound media size limit in MB.
